$comment: Pinned Arduino AVR core (ROADMAP P3-2): the Arduino API (cores/arduino), the Uno and Nano pin variants and the Wire library, compiled with the firmware by Triage's AVR build (sim/src/firmware.ts) when no Arduino IDE or arduino-cli install provides one. Not a fork: no patches; fetched with scripts/forks/fetch.mjs into engines/arduino-avr/upstream/.
